Dimer.description: Boosts the shot percentage for open teammates after catching a pass.

Physical Finisher.description: Improves a player's ability to battle through contact and convert contact layups.

Pogo Stick.description: Allows players to quickly recover and go back up for another jump upon landing. This could be after a rebound, block attempt, or even jumpshot.

Possession Closer.description: Boosts a player's ability to track down or grab rebounds on the defensive end.

Set and Fire.description: Applies a shooting boost to three-point attempts when the user's feet are completely set.

Slippery Off-Ball.description: When attempting to get open off screens, the player more effectively navigates through traffic.

Static Middy.description: Applies a shooting boost to stand-still mid-range shots.

Versatile Visionary.description: Improves a player's ability to thread and fit tight passes, including alley-oops, quickly and on time.

Aerial Wizard.description: Increases the ability to finish an alley-oop from a teammate, or a putback finish off an offensive rebound.

Bail Out.description: Passing out of a jump shot or layup yields fewer errant passes than normal. Additionally, helps passing out of double teams.

Boxout Boss.description: Increases the success rate of boxouts as the boxer.

Break Starter.description: After grabbing a defensive board, deep outlet passes made up the court are more accurate. Passes must be made quickly following the defensive rebound.

Float Game.description: Improves a player's ability to make floaters.

Ghost Stepper.description: Increases the effectiveness on step-through layups or other close-range shots that come after a fake.

High-Flying Denier.description: Boosts the speed and leaping ability of a defensive player in anticipation of a chase down block attempt.

Layup Mixmaster.description: Improves a player's ability to finish fancy or acrobatic layups successfully.

Paint Prodigy.description: Improves a player's ability to quickly and efficiently score while going to work in the paint.

Post Fade Phenom.description: Improves a player's ability to make post fades and hop shots.

Strong Handle.description: Reduces the likelihood of being bothered by defenders when dribbling.

Sync Snatcher.description: Gives an additional vertical and rebounding boost when perfectly timing the jump.

Work Horse.description: Increases player speed and agility when chasing down loose balls.

Crasher.description: Boosts a player's ability to track down or grab rebounds on the offensive end.

Smooth Operator.description: Improves a player's ability to knock down mid-range shots while on the move., including pull-up, hop, or spin shots.

Pick Dodger.description: Improves a player's ability to navigate through and around screens while on defense.

Challenger.description: Improves effectiveness of well-timed contests against perimeter shooters.

Seatbelt.description: Boosts body-up defense effectiveness, making it easier to clamp opponents and disrupt their drive path.

Ankle Braces.description: Lowers the likelihood of getting ankle-broken by opposing dribble moves.

Arc Cadence.description: Improves a player's ability to knock down three-point shots while on the move., including pull-up, hop, or spin shots.

Glove.description: Increases the ability to successfully steal from ball-handlers, or strip layup attempts.

Interceptor.description: The frequency of successfully tipped or intercepted passes greatly increases.

Off-Ball Pest.description: Makes players more difficult to get past when playing off-ball, as they can grab and hold their matchup.

Quick Trigger.description: Improves a player's ability to make 'No Dip' jumpshots.

Deadeye.description: Jump shots taken with a defender closing out receive less of a penalty from a shot contest.

Flash.description: Speeds up movement without the ball while in transition on offense or defense.

Lightning Launch.description: Speeds up launches when attacking from the perimeter.

Mini Marksman.description: Elevates the likelihood of making shots over taller defenders.

Ankle Assassin.description: Increases the ability to break down the defender or cross them up.

Handles for Days.description: A player takes less of an energy hit when performing consecutive dribble moves, allowing them to chain together combos quicker and for longer periods of time.

Limitless Range.description: Extends the range from which a player can shoot three-pointers effectively from deep.

Pace.description: Raises the speed of the ball handler when sprinting.

Unpluckable.description: Defenders have a tougher time poking the ball free with their steal attempts.

Immovable Enforcer.description: Improves a defensive player's strength when defending ball handlers and finishers who are coming straight at them.

Breaker.description: Increases the success rate of breaking through opponent boxouts.

Bruiser.description: Drains energy from opponents when making physical contact.

Post Powerhouse.description: Strengthens a player's ability at backing down defenders and moving them with dropsteps.

Posterizer.description: Increases the chances of throwing down a dunk on your defender.

Rise Up.description: Increases the likelihood of dunking or posterizing your opponent when standing in the painted area.

Wall Up.description: Improves shot contest effectiveness during hands-up defense when guarding the paint.

Post Spin Catalyst.description: Attempting to do post spins or drives results in more effective moves, and less of a chance to be stripped.

Hook Specialist.description: Improves a player's ability to make post hooks.

Post Lockdown.description: Strengthens a player's ability to effectively defend moves in the post, with an increased chance at stripping the opponent.

Paint Patroller.description: Increases a player's ability to block or contest shots at the rim.

lines.Aerial Wizard: Throw him a lob and he'll catch it and slam it. He's also great at tipping in a missed shot.
lines.Ankle Assassin: His crossover is so quick the defender's feet get tangled — that's what "breaking ankles" means.
lines.Ankle Braces: The reverse of Ankle Assassin: fancy dribble moves don't fool him. He stays on his feet.
lines.Arc Cadence: He can make threes while moving — pull-ups, hops, even spinning into the shot.
lines.Bail Out: If he jumps to shoot and changes his mind, he can still throw a good pass instead of a bad one.
lines.Boxout Boss: He gets his body between the other guy and the basket, so the rebound comes to his team.
lines.Break Starter: Grab the rebound, fire it up the court — his long outlet passes hit the runner in stride.
lines.Breaker: When someone tries to box him out, he pushes right through and gets the rebound anyway.
lines.Brick Wall: When he sets a screen, defenders bounce off. It's like running into a wall.
lines.Bruiser: Every time he bumps into someone, they get tired faster. He wears people out.
lines.Challenger: Put a hand up at the right moment and the shooter misses. He's a great closer on jump shots.
lines.Crasher: He chases his own team's misses and grabs offensive rebounds other people give up on.
lines.Deadeye: A defender running at him doesn't matter — he still makes the shot.
lines.Dimer: His passes are so good his teammates shoot better right after catching them.
lines.Flash: He runs faster than everyone without the ball, on a fast break or getting back on defense.
lines.Float Game: He makes floaters — that soft, high shot over a big defender's hands.
lines.Ghost Stepper: Fake once, step through, lay it in. His close shots after a fake go in more.
lines.Glove: He steals the ball from dribblers and knocks it away when someone goes up for a layup.
lines.Handles for Days: He can string dribble moves together over and over without getting tired.
lines.High-Flying Denier: When someone runs out for a layup, he chases him down from behind and blocks it.
lines.Hook Specialist: He makes hook shots — the one-handed shot big men flip over the top of a defender.
lines.Immovable Enforcer: Drive straight at him and you'll bounce off. He's super strong on defense.
lines.Interceptor: He reads passes and picks them off like a cornerback.
lines.Layup Mixmaster: Spinning, reverse, acrobatic layups — the fancy ones — go in for him.
lines.Lightning Launch: His first step is lightning fast, so he blows past his defender from the three-point line.
lines.Limitless Range: He can make threes from way, way beyond the line — Steph Curry distance.
lines.Mini Marksman: Even when a taller guy is on him, he can still shoot over the top.
lines.Off-Ball Pest: He's annoying to play against — he grabs and bumps his man so he can't get open.
lines.Pace: When he sprints with the ball, he's faster than most.
lines.Paint Patroller: He guards the basket — blocks and bothers shots right at the rim.
lines.Paint Prodigy: Give him the ball near the basket and he scores fast, before help arrives.
lines.Physical Finisher: Bump him on his way to the hoop and he'll still finish the layup.
lines.Pick Dodger: Screens don't stop him on defense — he slips around them and sticks to his man.
lines.Pogo Stick: He jumps, lands, and jumps again right away — like a pogo stick — for rebounds and blocks.
lines.Possession Closer: When the other team misses, he grabs the rebound and the possession is over.
lines.Post Fade Phenom: With his back to the basket, he leans away and makes the fadeaway.
lines.Post Lockdown: Try to back him down near the basket and he holds his ground — and might steal it.
lines.Post Powerhouse: He backs defenders down under the basket and moves them out of the way.
lines.Post Spin Catalyst: His spin moves near the basket work more, and nobody strips the ball away.
lines.Posterizer: He dunks ON people. Jump to block it and you end up on a poster.
lines.Quick Trigger: He shoots the instant he catches it — no dip, no wasted motion — and still makes it.
lines.Rise Up: Standing under the basket, he just goes straight up and dunks on whoever is there.
lines.Seatbelt: He clamps down on his man like a seatbelt — you're not driving past him.
lines.Set and Fire: Feet set, catch, shoot — his standing-still threes get a big boost.
lines.Slippery Off-Ball: He slides around screens and through crowds to get himself open.
lines.Smooth Operator: He makes mid-range shots on the move — pull-ups off the dribble.
lines.Static Middy: Standing still from mid-range, he's money.
lines.Strong Handle: Defenders reaching in don't bother his dribble.
lines.Sync Snatcher: Time the jump perfectly and he jumps higher and snatches the rebound.
lines.Unpluckable: Nobody can poke the ball away from him when he's dribbling.
lines.Versatile Visionary: He threads passes through tiny gaps — lobs, bounce passes, all of it, right on time.
lines.Wall Up: Hands straight up under the basket, he makes shots hard to get off without fouling.
lines.Work Horse: Loose ball on the floor? He's the fastest to it, every time.
